instruments.name: California Consumer Privacy Act as amended by the CPRA (Cal. Civ. Code 1798.100 et seq.)

facet_hints.thresholds: CCPA applies only above business thresholds (revenue, volume of consumers, or share of revenue from selling or sharing). Establish whether the thresholds are met before reporting obligations — a student project usually is not covered, and saying so plainly is more useful than a false gap.
facet_hints.sale_sharing: 'Sale' and 'sharing' are defined broadly enough to catch advertising pixels and some analytics; opt-out rights follow.
facet_hints.sensitive_pi: Sensitive personal information has a separate right to limit use.
facet_hints.rights: Access, deletion, correction, portability, opt-out of sale/sharing, limit use of sensitive PI, and non-discrimination for exercising them.
facet_hints.contracts: Service provider and contractor contract terms are prescribed.
facet_hints.enforcement: Search CPPA and California Attorney General enforcement actions.

seed_obligations.title: Determine whether the business thresholds are met
Provide an opt-out of sale or sharing, including a recognised opt-out preference signal
applies_when: sells or shares personal information, including via advertising or analytics tags
testable_as: a Do Not Sell or Share link

seed_obligations.title: Honour consumer rights requests within the statutory periods
testable_as: a deletion path that reaches service providers

seed_obligations.title: Include the prescribed terms in contracts with service providers and contractors
applies_when: discloses personal information to a vendor
testable_as: contract terms restricting retention, use and disclosure
